baseline_models.mechanism: The summons captures a whole bodily vector: sustained sight, pitched head and neck, forward speed, and submissive compliance all align on the caller.

activation_trace.role: Sustained visual facing supplies the eyes-first alignment toward the caller.
The pitched neck and head give the alignment a visible bodily geometry.
Forward haste converts fixed orientation into rapid approach.
Submission explains why the same motion is compliance rather than eager choice.
Vocal calling and inclination provide the attracting endpoint of the bodily vector.

changed_reading.before: A crowd merely hurries toward someone calling.
changed_reading.after: The caller captures gaze, posture, velocity, and compliance, producing a total bodily alignment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The split mapping of the call root lets audible summons coexist with shove and driving rebuke, so voice behaves like applied force.

activation_trace.role: The dominant branch supplies an audible call that inclines hearers toward an endpoint.
The mapped forceful shove turns inclination into a pressure exerted on bodies.
Calling used as a driving rebuke links sound to compelled herd-like motion.
Forward haste is the observable motion produced by that pressure.

changed_reading.before: The caller issues an invitation and the crowd responds.
changed_reading.after: The call itself acts as an acoustic shove, driving the crowd into forward motion.

baseline_models.mechanism: Those characterized by covering truth are made to voice the event's severity; the split speech mapping adds bodily tremor, making their sentence an involuntary exposure rather than detached commentary.

activation_trace.role: Concealment of truth names the speakers by their prior epistemic action.
Overt utterance forces their appraisal out into audible form.
The mapped tremor makes speech leak bodily disturbance as well as propositional content.
Day as an event and its severity makes the deictic identify a happening, not merely a date.
Difficulty and pressure are the condition their own speech now discloses.

changed_reading.before: The disbelievers calmly label a difficult calendar day.
changed_reading.after: The coverers become self-exposing witnesses: their audible, tremor-marked sentence identifies the severe event they can no longer conceal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Temporal nearness followed by splitting turns the focus day from a remote date into a threshold already opening, with the summons gathering bodies into its realized pressure.

activation_trace.role: The day is available as a severe event rather than only a calendar unit.
Difficulty names the pressure experienced inside that event.
Temporal nearness supplies an event whose onset has approached rather than an indefinite future.
Splitting and opening give that onset the form of a breached threshold.

structural_cues: 54:1 announces nearness and rupture before 54:8 uses the proximal هَٰذَا for the day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-time, rupture, and a proximal severe day; I supply the arrow from rupture to opened threshold. A live alternative is that 54:1 only dates the later scene without supplying its mechanics.

changed_reading.before: This is a hard day that has simply arrived.
changed_reading.after: This is the pressure of a threshold whose opening has already begun and whose summons now draws everyone across it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence of seeing, turning the flank away, and verbally diverting the sign is reversed: eyes are lowered yet held in orientation, bodies face the caller, and speech registers severity instead of neutralizing the seen thing.

activation_trace.role: Sustained facing prevents the former visual disengagement.
Their new spoken label exposes the event's pressure.
Ordinary sight supplies the first stage of the earlier attention cycle.
Turning one's side supplies the prior bodily technique of visual refusal.
Diversion and deception characterize the earlier verbal reframing of what was seen.
Lowering and submission remove the confident posture that supported turning away.
The explicit eyes connect lowered sight directly to the focus's sustained visual orientation.

structural_cues: 54:2 orders seeing, turning away, and saying; 54:7-8 orders lowered eyes, directed motion, and saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed ocular-speech sequences; I treat the later sequence as reversal of the earlier coping loop. The live alternative is that lowered eyes and sustained orientation describe separate aspects without deliberate contrast.

changed_reading.before: The crowd looks toward a caller and comments on the day.
changed_reading.after: A former see-turn-label defense is disabled: their bodies cannot turn away and their speech now confesses the event's force.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following self-directed inclinations is replaced by movement along the caller's imposed vector; the affair's settling removes the open-ended drift of appetite.

activation_trace.role: Forward haste is the new directed movement.
The caller supplies the external endpoint that replaces self-selected direction.
Following and going behind establish the earlier movement pattern.
Inclination of the self identifies the earlier vector as internally chosen.
Settlement and fixity supply the closure toward which drifting choices move.

structural_cues: 54:3 has them follow their inclinations; 54:8 has them hurry toward the caller.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two different objects of directed movement and an eventual settling; I read them as a reversal of agency. Alternatively, following desire may explain denial without functioning as a motion counterpart.

changed_reading.before: They happen to move quickly toward the caller.
changed_reading.after: Their self-chosen following is inverted into compelled following: appetite no longer sets the route, and the caller does.

context_deltas.mechanism: News, vocal restraint, wisdom, and warnings reach their limit without sufficing; the later call therefore changes from information that may be resisted into an operative summons to a strange, painful event.

activation_trace.role: The focus caller supplies the operative voice at the end of the warning sequence.
The day as severe event is what the operative voice makes present.
Vocal rebuke supplies an earlier speech act intended to stop or correct.
Arrival at the limit marks the completion of communicated wisdom.
Failure of sufficiency marks warning as no longer able to alter the hearers.
Warning that should awaken caution supplies the resisted informational mode.
The repeated verb and caller announce the shift from prior warning to a concrete summons.
A hard, strange object gives the summons an encountered destination.
Painful punishment confirms the later mode as enacted consequence.

structural_cues: 54:4-5 closes a warning sequence as ineffective; 54:6 begins the day of calling; 54:16 pairs enacted punishment with warnings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completed but ineffective warning, a later call, a strange destination, and punishment; I supply the transition from communicative to operative speech. An alternative is that the caller remains another warner whose response merely happens to be unavoidable.

changed_reading.before: The caller delivers one more message about a hard day.
changed_reading.after: The caller no longer offers resistible information; the voice executes the warned transition and brings hearers into the event.

context_deltas.mechanism: Emergence from graves first produces a stripped, spreading locust-like multitude; orientation to the caller then converts radial dispersion into a single directed flow.

activation_trace.role: Forward haste supplies the directed phase of the crowd's motion.
The caller supplies the common attractor that aligns many trajectories.
Passage to the outside supplies the crowd's release from enclosed origins.
The grave identifies those enclosed origins as many separated sites.
Locusts supply the material image of a numerous mobile swarm.
Opening, spreading, and branching describe the swarm's initially divergent trajectories.

structural_cues: 54:7 ends with a spreading swarm; 54:8 immediately gives it the directional phrase إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, spread, swarm, and a common endpoint; I infer a phase change from dispersion to convergence. The alternative is simultaneous spread across the ground while all members retain the same destination.

changed_reading.before: A preformed crowd rushes in one direction.
changed_reading.after: The caller vectorizes a newly released swarm, converting grave-by-grave dispersion into convergent collective motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A call from defeat is followed by opened gates, released flows, and measured convergence; the focus caller can therefore be read as the terminal relay of a prior call whose answer reorganizes both world and bodies.

activation_trace.role: The focus caller is the later vocal node toward which bodies incline.
Forward haste shows the later call's bodily result.
An earlier upward call supplies the initiating vocal act in the relay.
Overpowering force supplies the defeated condition from which that call arises.
Aid and vindication identify the requested reversal of force.
Opening a closed passage begins the material answer.
Pouring and downflow give the answer directional force.
Two opposed flows meeting supplies a convergence pattern echoed by bodies reaching one caller.
Agreement with a set measure makes convergence ordered rather than accidental.

structural_cues: 54:10 call and plea is followed by 54:11-12 opening, flow, and meeting; 54:8 supplies another caller and converging movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the plea, material reorganization, and later caller; I infer an answer-and-relay arrow between them. A live alternative is that the flood sequence only exemplifies warning and does not define the focus call's agency.

changed_reading.before: The focus caller is an isolated official issuing a command.
changed_reading.after: The caller is a terminal relay in a call-and-answer chain whose answer has already shown power to redirect world and crowd.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied one is carried and moves under protective sight, while those who perform concealment later move under compelled sight; the focus stages exposure as the inverse of protected being-seen.

activation_trace.role: Sustained visual orientation supplies the compelled gaze regime.
The coverers of truth are the subjects placed under that compelled regime.
Bearing an exposed load supplies preservation through supported movement.
Flowing movement supplies the protected counterpart to the crowd's forced movement.
The eye of care defines being seen as protection rather than exposure.
The repeated concealment root relocates denial from the focus agents to what was done to the protected one.

structural_cues: 54:13-14 joins carried motion, protective eyes, and passive KFR; 54:8 joins compelled eyes, motion, and active KFR agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two motion-eye-KFR configurations; I assign them opposed protective and exposing functions. The alternative is that the repeated eye and KFR roots connect lexically without defining two gaze regimes.

changed_reading.before: The coverers simply look toward the caller while approaching.
changed_reading.after: Their fixed gaze is judicial exposure, set against the earlier protected movement of the one whose truth had been covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: A visible trace is left, warning is repeated, and recitation is made easy for recollection; the focus difficulty is therefore not lack of access but the hard encounter that follows covered, unacted-on accessibility.

activation_trace.role: Concealment of truth supplies the active response to accessible warning.
Difficulty names the later encountered condition rather than the communication's availability.
A remaining trace supplies durable evidence rather than a vanished message.
The visible sign makes the retained trace available for recognition.
Recollection states the intended cognitive uptake of the trace.
Painful consequence identifies what the warning was meant to avert.
Repeated warning confirms that caution had been actively awakened.
Ease after difficulty supplies the explicit counterweight to the focus adjective.
Recitation identifies what has been made easy and repeatably accessible.
Repeated recollection frames ease as an offered route to retained awareness.

structural_cues: 54:15 leaves a sign for recollection, 54:16 names punishment and warning, and 54:17 explicitly opposes ease to the focus's عَسِر.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retained sign, repeated recollection, easy recitation, warning, and later difficulty; I infer that hardness belongs to encounter after refusal rather than to inaccessible guidance. The alternative is a general consolation about recitation with no causal contrast to 54:8.

changed_reading.before: The day is hard because reality and warning were difficult to grasp.
changed_reading.after: The warning was retained and made easy to recall; what becomes hard is the unavoidable encounter after accessible truth was covered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because natal mechanics are a distant branch and the context never names birth. It remains anchored because عسر supplies difficult delivery and premature taking, while graves, خروج, and the earth's bursting supply forced emergence. Render only as a birth-like material analogy, not as the lexical gloss of the ayah.

activation_trace.role: Difficult delivery supplies the branch image of obstructed emergence.
Taking or mounting before preparation supplies the crowd's unreadiness for emergence.
Forward haste turns emergence immediately into compelled movement.
Passage out of enclosure supplies the explicit emergence.
Graves provide the enclosing sites from which bodies emerge.
Wide splitting and release give the earth an earlier image of forced opening.

changed_reading.before: The difficult day is generic adversity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the day behaves like a difficult delivery: the earth opens and ejects unready bodies directly into compelled motion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines a form-distant mapped call branch with flood mechanics. It remains anchored in the caller, hurrying bodies, pouring, meeting, and measured fit. Render as a cross-domain model of mass convergence, never as a claim that the crowd is literally liquid or that دَاع means a vessel.

activation_trace.role: Shaking a receptacle until it fills supplies a form-distant packing mechanism for the summons.
Forceful pushing supplies the pressure that moves the mass.
Forward haste is the human-scale flow produced by that pressure.
Pouring and downflow supply the surrounding material analogy.
Opposed flows meeting supply the convergence operation.
Meeting a prescribed fit supplies the endpoint of packing and convergence.

changed_reading.before: The caller verbally gathers separate people.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the summons acts like pressure packing a released mass into measured convergence, as the paired waters were made to meet.

strongest_changes: The earlier see-turn-label cycle becomes fixed orientation and involuntary acknowledgment.
A dispersed grave-born swarm is vectorized into convergent motion toward one caller.
Completed but ineffective warning becomes an operative summons that executes the warned event.
Easy retained recollection is contrasted with the hard encounter that follows concealment.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah tightly couples eye, neck, speed, voice, concealment, and event-pressure. Split mappings added an acoustic shove to د ع و and bodily tremor to ق و ل, while the local sequence supplied reversals of attention and agency plus material models of convergence.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ه ط ع foregrounds gaze, neck posture, speed, or submission while allowing the others to remain active.
Whether the mapped د ع ع and ق ل ل branches describe live mechanics or only exploratory phonological resonance.
Whether هَٰذَا points chiefly to the day, the called-to strange thing, or the immediate call-event.
Whether the delivery and hydraulic models explain the scene or remain suggestive cross-domain echoes.
